compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from bug tapestried-oversize-blackfly (rebar sent `temperature` to Bedrock models that reject it). That bug makes sampling opt-in from a code-resident, measured allowlist (`_SAMPLING_ACCEPTING_MODEL_IDS` in `src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py`). An operator who runs a model rebar has not measured can neither enable sampling for a model that accepts it nor withhold it from one rebar wrongly lists, without a rebar release. The operator report asked for "operator-declared capabilities in config" (suggestion 2). Repo policy forbids adding a config key in a bug fix, so it is filed here.

## Evidence (from the bug)

Measured 2026-11-11 on Bedrock Converse us-west-2: Claude Opus 4.7+, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, and the 5.5 family reject `temperature` 0/0.7 and `top_p` but accept `temperature=1.0`; OpenAI GPT-5.5/GPT-6.1 Sol and Moonshot Kimi K3.1 reject all temperature and topP values; Claude 4.5/4.6, Nova Pro, Llama 4 Maverick, Pixtral Large and DeepSeek R1 accept all. New ids arrive faster than releases.

## Approach (to be designed)

A `[llm.model_capabilities."<model id>"]` table (or equivalent) in `rebar.toml` whose rows override the measured table per exact id, at least `supports_temperature`; recorded in verdict provenance as operator-declared. Needs a `# mechanism-ok: config_key` marker naming this story.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An operator can declare that a model accepts or rejects sampling in config, and the runner honours it (unit test on the Bedrock converse request).
- [ ] The declaration is visible in signed provenance.
- [ ] `docs/config.md` documents the key.
compiled_state.title: Let operators declare per-model sampling capabilities in config
